text: During execution, `InitDefaultVersionFlag` does nothing if `Command.Version` is empty or a `version` flag already exists. Otherwise it adds Boolean `--version`, gives it `-v` if that shorthand is free, and annotates it with `FlagSetByCobraAnnotation` (`command.go:1200-1225`). Completion logic recognizes a changed Cobra-created version flag through that annotation (`completions.go:522-533`).
